messages:
Amanda L: Heads-up — Ridgeview (dedicated customer) requested a pinned model for their cutover next week. Proposal: pin to model-redwood-3.1.2-quant and run a two-stage canary during a maintenance window Tue 2026-03-31 02:00-04:00 UTC. cc @Josh W @Priya S
Josh W: Ack. Quick Q — what rollback target are we planning? last perf run on quant had a p95 tail around 450ms under certain batches.
Priya S: We recommended 3.1.2-quant after QA. Ops asks for canary details: 2 canary slices, 30m each, metrics gating: p95 < 300ms and error rate < 0.5% relative to baseline. If breach, immediate rollback to 3.0.9.
Carlos M: Infra check — we can reserve a dedicated GPU pool in us-west-2 for that 2-hour window. Need runbook edits for traffic-shift and pool pinning. Also ensure autoscale disabled for the slice during canary.
Evan P: Release notes draft: "KV-cache optimizations for long contexts; streaming header fix; improved quantization stability". I'll attach tenant-facing notes and the internal changelog. Add fallback policy details (auto fallback to smaller model on severe latency).
Amanda L: @deploy-bot please schedule the canary job for Ridgeview and tag the run with the pinned-version and rollback-label.
deploy-bot: Job scheduled: ridgeview/pin/2212345678 by Amanda L | window 2026-03-31T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-31T04:00:00Z | steps: canary-1(30m), canary-2(30m), staged-shift(60m) | rollback: 3.0.9 | runbook: ops/ridgeview-pin-v1
Priya S: Add these health probes for gating: /internal/health?env=dedicated (status, gen_latency_p95, error_rate) and trace token sampling at 1%. Also collect per-model-version gen latency histograms and request-level logs to S3 for 24h.
Carlos M: Ops checklist updated: https://intranet.redwood/ops/checklists/ridgeview-pin (internal). Items: reserve pool, disable autoscale, load-test warmup, validate KV cache priming, monitor shredder queue.
Josh W: Approvals? @Evan P @Carlos M — can you confirm infra and product sign-off so I can mark the RFC approved?
Evan P: :thumbsup: Approved. Make sure the release notes include the fallback policy and the communication blurb to Ridgeview SEs.
Carlos M: infra ok. Pool reserved and runbook updated.
Amanda L: Final: canary plan & pin to 3.1.2-quant approved. Rolling policy: if canary gate fails, operator runs rollback command and opens an incident. Snippet for ops: ```
/deploy rollback --tenant ridgeview --to 3.0.9 --reason "canary breach"
```
Amanda L: I'll send the tenant notice and attach the release notes. Thanks everyone.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-30T18:00:00Z "Preflight checklist for Ridgeview pin" sent to #eng-releases.
